title: ye bemisl nayaab duqtar mubarak
body:
ye bemisl nayaab duqtar mubarak
mubarak mubarak payambar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
sada har taraf se yahi aa rahi hai
rasoole quda ko ye duqtar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
mubarak hame naqshe paa fatima ka
tujhe aaina aye sikandar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ko ye roohe ula me keh rahe hai
ye joda tumhe dee'n ke rehbar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ko ye beti ali ko ye zouqa
ye shabbiro shabbar ko maadar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
mubarak hame ye gule baaghe wehdat
tujhe aye gulista'n gule tar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
ye aa aa ke kehte hai salmano boozar
ye beti janabe payambar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
khushi ki ye jaa hai masarrat ka din hai
ye eed aye ghulamaane hyder mubarak
